description: This source file defines the CheckoutModel class responsible for handling the checkout process in a Razor Pages web application for an e-commerce platform. It manages retrieving the user's basket, processing order submissions, handling authentication state, and error handling during checkout.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: A Razor PageModel class managing the checkout process, including basket retrieval, order creation, and user session handling.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the checkout page and initialize the basket model.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the checkout form, update basket quantities, create an order, and clear the basket.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the basket for the signed-in user or guest, based on authentication state.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the basket cookie or sets a new guest user identifier cookie.
